import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income Distribution by Education Level
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
education_order = ['PhD', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'Basic', '2n Cycle']
education_present = [ed for ed in education_order if ed in df['Education'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Education', x='Income', order=education_present, palette='Set2', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income')
ax1.set_ylabel('Education Level')

# 2. Total Spending by Product Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = df[spending_cols].sum()
spending_totals.index = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(spending_totals))
ax2.bar(range(len(spending_totals)), spending_totals.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(spending_totals)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(spending_totals.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Amount Spent')

# 3. Customer Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
current_year = 2014  # Based on dates in data
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
ax3.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax3.axvline(df['Age'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {df["Age"].mean():.1f}')
ax3.legend()

# 4. Purchase Channels Comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
purchase_channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_totals = df[purchase_channels].sum()
channel_totals.index = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
colors_channels = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(channel_totals))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(channel_totals.values, labels=channel_totals.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_channels, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Purchase Distribution by Channel', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Income vs Total Spending Scatter
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], 
                     c=df['Age'], cmap='coolwarm', alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax5.set_xlabel('Income')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Spending')
ax5.set_title('Income vs Total Spending (colored by Age)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5, label='Age')

# 6. Marital Status Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
colors_marital = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(marital_counts))
ax6.barh(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, color=colors_marital)
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
ax6.set_yticklabels(marital_counts.index)
ax6.set_title('Customer Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Count')
ax6.set_ylabel('Marital Status')

# 7. Children at Home Impact on Spending
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
kids_spending = df.groupby('TotalKids')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax7.bar(kids_spending.index, kids_spending.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Number of Children at Home')
ax7.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending')
ax7.set_title('Average Spending by Number of Children', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xticks(kids_spending.index)

# 8. Campaign Acceptance Rates
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = df[campaign_cols].sum()
acceptance_rates.index = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response']
colors_camp = sns.color_palette('Set3', len(acceptance_rates))
ax8.bar(range(len(acceptance_rates)), acceptance_rates.values, color=colors_camp, edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_xticks(range(len(acceptance_rates)))
ax8.set_xticklabels(acceptance_rates.index, rotation=45)
ax8.set_title('Marketing Campaign Acceptance', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Acceptances')

# 9. Recency Distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.hist(df['Recency'], bins=20, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax9.set_xlabel('Recency (days)')
ax9.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax9.set_title('Customer Purchase Recency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.axvline(df['Recency'].median(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, 
           label=f'Median: {df["Recency"].median():.0f}')
ax9.legend()

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Data Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
